verdict.line: You lose if you tap Malphite's Granite Shield with random autos and burn cooldowns before it's actually down; you win if you time your all-in for when Fury is above 50 and the shield hasn't recharged.

brief.thesis: Renekton's empowered W (Ruthless Predator, 50+ Fury) explicitly destroys damage shields on the target — which shreds Malphite's Granite Shield outright instead of just chipping it. That single interaction is why Renekton holds a 51.7-point lane and solo-kill edge here: whoever manages the shield-recharge timer wins the trade, and Renekton has the tool built to delete it. The 47.6% overall win rate over 1802 games says Malphite claws it back late via armor-scaling Ground Slam and a 1000-range Unstoppable Force engage that out-scales this lane lead.

tell.watch: Your Fury bar vs their shield

theirWindow.when: Granite Shield charged, your Fury under 50
theirWindow.what: Don't dash in with E (Slice and Dice) yet — a non-empowered hit just splashes off the shield. Poke with autos and Q (Cull the Meek, 7s cooldown) first to force the shield down and feed your own Fury before committing.

yourWindow.what: Full commit: W (Ruthless Predator) now fires three slashes, strips the shield, and stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Follow with E for the armor shred and Q for the boosted heal — this is the trade Malphite can't out-value.

powerCurve.note: Malphite Q pokes safely at 625 range, no stun yet
W stun online, E dash punishes overextension
R plus 50+ Fury combos shred Granite Shield hard
Armor-scaling E and 1000-range R take over fights

start.why: 48.1% win rate over 1286 games — the extra damage and sustain matter here since your job is landing enough autos to hit 50 Fury before every trade.

boots.why: 64% pick rate and 48.7% win rate; Malphite's Q, E, and R all deal magic damage, and the tenacity keeps you from getting chain-CC'd out of your own all-in.

core.why: Highest-value first item in the top build path (54.3% over 151 games) — the proc shield absorbs Malphite's Q or E poke during your engage window.
Armor shred stacks with your empowered E's own armor reduction, letting your Q and W hit through Malphite's stacked resistances.
Bleeds through Malphite's burst and Granite Shield-backed poke, letting you stay in extended trades once you're already ahead in lane.

situational.when: malphite is stacking armor and out-tanking your burst in extended fights
you're snowballing lane and want faster W/E loops to keep re-testing the shield timer
you're grouping with an AD carry to convert your all-ins into teamfight pressure

runes.keystoneWhy: The most-picked page (36%) at 47.7% win rate — the stacking adaptive force and healing reward exactly the repeated-trade, Fury-farming pattern this matchup demands.

summoners.why: 71.9% pick rate at 48.5% win rate, and it matches the data's own solo-kill advantage for Renekton — Ignite closes out the all-in once the shield is stripped and Malphite can't heal through it.

playing.title: Bait the shield before you dash
playing.detail: Never open with E into a fresh Granite Shield. Land an auto or a Q first so the shield absorbs that instead of your real damage.

playing.title: Track your own Fury, not the clock
playing.detail: Your all-in timing is gated by hitting 50+ Fury, not by cooldowns being up. Weave autos between spells specifically to cross that threshold before you commit W.

playing.title: Respect Ground Slam in extended trades
playing.detail: E (Ground Slam) cuts your attack speed and deals armor-scaling magic damage on a 7s cooldown. Don't stand in prolonged auto-trades once Malphite starts landing it — burst and disengage instead.

playing.title: Dodge the level 1-2 Q pokes
playing.detail: At 625 range with only an 8s cooldown, Malphite's Q wins every free trade before your W is online at level 3. Play side-to-side in minion waves rather than face-tanking it.

playing.title: Use E to punish, not just to engage
playing.detail: Slice and Dice's dash lets you close distance the instant Malphite oversteps for CS or vision — you don't need Fury for this, just distance.

playing.title: Front-load your aggression
playing.detail: Your lane edge exists levels 3-11; push it hard for kills, plates, and jungle pressure before Malphite's armor stacking and Unstoppable Force flip the matchup late.

playing.title: Play around their R range post-6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force reaches 1000 range and only gets stronger with rank. Don't overextend past minion waves once Malphite hits level 6, even if you're winning the 1v1.

brief.patchCaveat: Build path, rune page, summoner spells, and every win rate/sample size above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG. The mechanical reasoning — the Granite Shield/empowered-W interaction, the power curve, and the trade patterns — is my own read of the ability kits, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Malphite’s (Q). Build up Fury while using your abilities off cooldown to apply pressure in order to gain lane control.
